name: Tretinoin Cream (0.1%) - 20g
description: Our strongest tretinoin strength, a retinoid used for acne, uneven texture and visible signs of ageing. Best suited to skin that is already used to retinoids.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to clean, dry skin in the evening. Start 2–3 nights a week and build up gradually. Always use SPF 30+ during the day.
ingredients: Tretinoin 0.1% w/w in a cream base.

name: Tretinoin Cream (0.05%) - 20g
description: A mid-strength tretinoin cream, a good next step once your skin has adjusted to a lower strength.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to clean, dry skin in the evening. Start 2–3 nights a week and build up gradually. Always use SPF 30+ during the day.
ingredients: Tretinoin 0.05% w/w in a cream base.

name: Tretinoin Cream (0.025%) - 20g
description: Our gentlest tretinoin strength and the usual starting point for people new to retinoids.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to clean, dry skin in the evening. Start 2–3 nights a week and build up gradually. Always use SPF 30+ during the day.
ingredients: Tretinoin 0.025% w/w in a cream base.

name: Azelaic Acid Cream (20%) - 20g
description: A high-strength azelaic acid cream that targets blemishes, redness and post-acne marks.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer to affected areas twice daily, morning and evening, after cleansing.
ingredients: Azelaic acid 20% w/w in a cream base.

name: Azelaic Acid Cream (10%) - 30g
description: A gentler azelaic acid cream for sensitive skin, uneven tone and dullness.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer to clean skin once or twice daily.
ingredients: Azelaic acid 10% w/w in a cream base.

name: Tazarotene Cream (0.1%) - 20g
description: A strong third-generation retinoid cream for acne and texture.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin once in the evening. Use SPF 30+ daily.
ingredients: Tazarotene 0.1% w/w in a cream base.

name: Tazarotene Gel (0.05%) - 20g
description: A lightweight tazarotene gel, well suited to oily and combination skin.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin once in the evening. Use SPF 30+ daily.
ingredients: Tazarotene 0.05% w/w in a gel base.

name: Estriol Cream BP (0.1%) - 15g
howToUse: Use as directed by your prescriber.
ingredients: Estriol 0.1% w/w in a cream base.

name: Hydroquinone Cream (4%) - 20g
description: A targeted treatment for dark spots, melasma and hyperpigmentation.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer to affected areas only, once or twice daily. Do not use continuously for more than 3 months. Use SPF 30+ daily.
ingredients: Hydroquinone 4% w/w in a cream base.
